kjv: by every [word] that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD
mine: by everything that comes out of the mouth of Yahweh
note: Hebrew kol motsa' pi-YHWH, "all that goes out of Yahweh's mouth", has no noun "word"; in context it includes the manna God decreed. The KJV supplies "word" (as Matt 4:4 does with rhema).
Hebrew nechoshet here is ore mined from the hills, i.e. copper; brass is a zinc alloy that is not mined.
